y-m-47-01.title: Zvinotaurwa nezvisingatauri nemhedzisiro yesurvey oga
y-m-47-01.topic: Huwandu hwema elements e union, uye kana ruzivo rwakakwana
y-m-47-01.goal: Tonga kana ruzivo nezve huwandu hwema elements esets rwakakwana, chinja mhedziso nerenji remakosha anogoneka kana ruzivo rutsva rwasvika, uye gadzira iwe pachako nyaya dzinogutsa mamiriro ose.
y-m-47-01.material: Vadzidzi vegore rekutanga 40 vechikoro vakabvunzwa kana vachiita zviitwa 'kushambira' ne 'kumhanya'. Mudzidzi anogona kuita zviitwa zvose zviviri, kana kuti kusaita chero chipi. Mudzidzi anoona nezve survey anokuudza mhedzisiro dzesurvey danho nedanho. Tonga kana ruzivo rwakapiwa runokubvumira kutara 'huwandu hwevadzidzi vanoita kushambira nekumhanya zvose'. (n(A) zvinoreva huwandu hwema elements eseti A uye inoverengwa 'n of A'.)
y-m-47-01.thinking.2: Kugadzira iwe pachako nyaya dzinogutsa mamiriro ose uye kutarisa renji rinogoneka
y-m-47-01.prereq.0: Mudzidzi anoziva zvinoreva sets, union ne intersection, nechiratidzo n(A) chehuwandu hwema elements (H1 yeboka iri inongova nhanho yekuoma neyerubatsiro uye haireve kuti yakagoverwa kugiredhi rakati. Fungidzira kuti mudzidzi ari kudzidza chikamu che 'Sets and Propositions' che high school Common Mathematics.)
y-m-47-01.prereq.1: Ruzivo rwekuparadzanisa nekuverenga ma elements pasina kufukidzana uchishandisa Venn diagrams kana matafura
y-m-47-01.s.s1.prompt: Mudzidzi anoona nezve survey anokuudza mhedzisiro dzesurvey rimwe panguva. Nguva imwe neimwe ruzivo rutsva painouya, tarisazve kutonga kwako nezve 'huwandu hwevadzidzi vanoita zvose'.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.hint.0: Mumutsara mumwe, nyora kuti ruzivo rumwe nerumwe runokuudza chii nezvemapoka mana 'kushambira chete, kumhanya chete, zvose, hapana'.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.hint.1: Edza kuisa nhamba kuti mapoka mana awedzere kusvika ku40, uye utarise kana dzichisangana neruzivo.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Vadzidzi 25 vanoshambira, vadzidzi 22 vanomhanya, uye vadzidzi 40 vose vakapindura survey.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Vadzidzi vangani vanoita kushambira nekumhanya zvose?
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Hazvina kutarwa. Kana pasina anoita hapana, 7 vadzidzi vanofukidzana, uye kana pane vadzidzi vasingaiti chero chipi, vadzidzi vakawanda vanofukidzana. Makosha anogoneka anogona kudzikiswa kuva vadzidzi 7 kana kupfuura uye vadzidzi 22 kana pasi. 'Hazvina kutarwa sekukosha kumwe chete' ne 'tinoziva renji' hazvipokani.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Nhamba mbiri dzakawedzerwa dzinopfuura huwandu hwose hwe40, uye pamwe hauna kuverenga kuti musiyano uyu unoreva chii.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Kana waverenga 25+22−40, wakafungidzira kuti vadzidzi vose 40 vanoita imwe yezviitwa zviviri. Tarisazve kana ruzivo rwakadaro rwakapiwa.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Kutonga kwekuti hazvina kutarwa kunoshanda. Asi tarisa kana renji remakosha anogoneka rinogona kudzikiswa nemiganhu ye25, 22, nehuwandu hwose hwe40 chete.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Mhedzisiro yekutarisa yasvika. Vadzidzi vose 40 vanoita kushambira kana kumhanya.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.1.ask: Zvino vadzidzi vangani vanoita zviitwa zvose zviviri?
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.1.after: Vadzidzi vose 40 vanoita imwe yezviviri, saka huwandu hwevadzidzi vasingaiti hapana ndi0. Ipapo 7, iyo 25+22=47 kubvisa huwandu hwose hwe40, ihuwandu hwevadzidzi vakaverengwa kaviri, ndiko kuti, vadzidzi vanoita zviitwa zvose zviviri.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Hazvisati zvasarudzwa. Mutengo usingazivikanwi unoramba uripo
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Verenga zvakare kuti ruzivo rutsva runokuudza chii nezve 'vadzidzi vasingaiti chimwe'.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Tevera kuti 18 yakabva ku 40, 22, 25 ipi uye i huwandu hwevadzidzi vapi. Unofanira kutarisa kana yakaenzana nehuwandu hwevadzidzi hwaunoda kuwana.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.1.r.d: 22 i yakakura zvikuru pamitengo inogoneka. Tarisa kana ruzivo rutsva urwu runoita kuti ive mutengo uyo.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Kutarisa zvakare mibvunzo, 3 yacho yaiva nenyorwa 'haashambi kana kumhanya'. Ruzivo rwekare 'vadzidzi vese 40 vanoita chimwe zvishoma' rwaiva rwakaipa. Kushambira 25, kumhanya 22, nehuwandu hwese 40 zvinoramba sezvazviri.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Neruzivo rwakagadziriswa, vadzidzi vangani vanoita zviitiko zvese zviviri?
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.2.after: Huwandu hwevadzidzi vanoita chimwe pazviviri zvishoma i 40−3=37. Kubvisa 37 kubva ku 25+22=47 kunopa 10 vakaverengwa kaviri. Kana ruzivo rwagadziriswa, mhedziso yatopiwa (7) inofanirawo kugadziriswa.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Uyu i mutengo wakawanikwa neruzivo rwusati rwagadziriswa. Tarisa kana wakaratidza ruzivo rwakagadziriswa.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Kugadzirisa kwakatiudza huwandu hwevadzidzi vasingaiti chimwe. Tarisa kana chiri kusasarudzwa kunyange ruzivo rwakawedzera.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Kana 3 yakabviswa kubva ku 7, wana nenhamba kuti huwandu hwevadzidzi vakaverengwa kaviri hunochinja sei kana huwandu hwevadzidzi vasingaiti chimwe huchiwedzera.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga hazvaisati zvasarudzwa, uye ruzivo painowedzera mitengo inogoneka yakadzikira. Padanho rechitatu wakadzidza kuti mutengo wakanga wakasimbiswa kare (7) wakamira paruzivo rwakaipa, uye wakagadzirisa mhedziso. Taura kuti mhedziso yako yaitsamira paruzivo rupi.

y-m-47-05.material: 서윤 akagadzira mutemo. 'Kumaintegers maviri a, b, kana a²>b² saka a>b.' (a² inoverengwa 'a squared'.) Unoda kuedza kana mutemo uyu unoshanda zvechokwadi kumapeya ose emaintegers.

y-m-47-05.prereq.0: Zvirevo, zvinoreva counterexample, nekuverenga masquare emaintegers (H1 yebatch iyi inongova danho rekuoma netsigiro uye haireve kuti yakapiwa kugiredhi rakati. Fungidzira kuti mudzidzi ari kudzidza yuniti ye 'Sets and Propositions' yeCommon Mathematics yechikoro chepamusoro.)
y-m-47-05.prereq.1: Zvinobatsira kana wakaona factorization a²−b²=(a−b)(a+b), asi hazvidiwi
y-m-47-05.s.s1.prompt: 서윤 akagadzira mutemo 'Kumaintegers maviri a, b, kana a²>b² saka a>b.' (a² inoverengwa 'a squared'.) Wana (a, b) 3 dzakasiyana dzisingashandi mutemo uyu.
y-m-47-05.s.s1.hint.0: Chinja imwe ya a kana b kuita nhamba isina uye uenzanise masquare.
y-m-47-05.s.s1.hint.1: Zvakasiyana nenyaya a=3, b=2, edza muenzaniso umo unochinja zviratidzo kuti a irege kuva huru kupfuura b.
y-m-47-05.s.s1.fail.c2: Hypothesis a²>b² inofanira kushanda. Verenga masquare e a ne b zvakananga uye uaenzanise.
y-m-47-05.s.s1.fail.c3: Mhedziso a>b haifanire kushanda (a haifanire kuva huru kupfuura b).
y-m-47-05.s.s1.explain: Muenzaniso une a²>b² asi a≤b icounterexample. Kana (a, b)=(−3, 2), saka 9>4 asi −3<2. Counterexample imwe inoratidza kuti mutemo wenhema.
y-m-47-05.s.s2.prompt: Unoda kuwedzera mamiriro mamwe kuti mutemo ugare uri wechokwadi. Sarudza mamiriro ose anoita kuti ugare uri wechokwadi kana awedzerwa.
y-m-47-05.s.s2.hint.0: Kumamiriro esarudzo imwe neimwe, ongorora kana counterexample (a, b) yawakagadzira kare ichiita mamiriro.
y-m-47-05.s.s2.r.b: Mushure mekuwedzera a≠b, ongorora kana counterexample yawakagadzira kare ichisara.
y-m-47-05.s.s2.r.d: Mamiriro aya aivapo kubva pakutanga. Rangarira kana macounterexamples akabuda kunyange nemamiriro aya.
y-m-47-05.s.s2.o.e: Imwe ya a kana b kana kupfuura isina
y-m-47-05.s.s2.r.e: Ongorora kana counterexample sa (−3, 2) ichisara pasi pemamiriro aya.
y-m-47-05.s.s2.explain: a²−b²=(a−b)(a+b), saka kana a+b>0 ne a²>b², saka a−b>0, saka a>b. Kana a ne b zvose zvakanaka, a+b>0, saka nyaya iyi yechokwadiwo. Kuna a≠b, mamiriro eninteger, nemamiriro umo isina yakasanganiswa, counterexample sa (−3, 2) inosara.

y-m-47-04.title: Zvinogona kutongwa kana uchiziva huwandu hwema elements chete
y-m-47-04.topic: Huwandu hwema elements ema truth sets nechokwadi kana kunyepa kwe proposition
y-m-47-04.goal: Tonga kana huwandu hwema elements ema truth sets oga husarudza chokwadi kana kunyepa kwe 'kana p saka q', ronga kuti ruzivo rupi rwekuwedzera runosarudza, uye uise iwe pachako zviitiko zvinoita kuti ive yenhema.
y-m-47-04.material: Universal set U ine natural numbers 12 kubva ku 1 kusvika ku 12. Ngatitii ma truth sets emamiriro maviri p, q i P, Q, uye n(P)=4, n(Q)=7. (n(P) i huwandu hwema elements e P. Pᶜ i complement ye P, ∪ i union, uye ∩ i intersection.) Neruzivo urwu chete, unoda kutonga kana proposition 'kana p saka q' i yechokwadi kana yenhema.
y-m-47-04.thinking.1: Kuronga kuti ruzivo rupi rwekuwedzera runosarudza kutonga
y-m-47-04.thinking.2: Kugadzira nekutarisa zviitiko zvinoita kuti ive yenhema
y-m-47-04.prereq.0: Ma truth sets, ma subsets, hukama hwekuti 'kana proposition kana p saka q i yechokwadi, saka P⊂Q', nehuwandu hwema elements eseti (H1 yeseti iyi i danho rekunetsa nerekutsigira chete uye hazvireve kuti yakagoverwa kugiredhi riri rese. Fungidzira kuti mudzidzi ari kudzidza yuniti ye 'Sets and Propositions' yeCommon Mathematics yehigh school.)
y-m-47-04.prereq.1: Ruzivo rwekuverenga ne Venn diagrams kuti n(P∪Q) ne n(P∩Q) zvakabatana
y-m-47-04.s.s1.prompt: Uchiziva n(P)=4 ne n(Q)=7 chete, proposition 'kana p saka q' i yechokwadi kana yenhema? Sarudza kutonga kwakakodzera zvikuru.
y-m-47-04.s.s1.hint.0: Edza kana unogona kugadzira chiitiko chimwe apo P⊂Q uye chimwe apo kwete.
y-m-47-04.s.s1.hint.1: Mu U={1, 2, ..., 12}, sarudza ma elements mashoma e P ne Q imwe neimwe uye uanyore iwe pachako.
y-m-47-04.s.s1.o.a: I yechokwadi, nekuti n(P) i shoma kupfuura n(Q)
y-m-47-04.s.s1.r.a: Wakafunga kuti ine ma elements mashoma inoenda mukati meine akawanda. Edza kana nhamba oga ichigona kuudza kana ma elements e P ari chaizvo muna Q.
y-m-47-04.s.s1.o.b: Hazvigone kusarudzwa, nekuti hatizivi kana P iri mukati ma Q
y-m-47-04.s.s1.o.c: Hazvisi zvechokwadi, nokuti n(P) ne n(Q) zvakasiyana pakati pazvo
y-m-47-04.s.s1.r.c: Edza kana kuti nhamba dzakasiyana dzichiendera kumhedziso yekuti zvikamu zvaP hazvisi muQ.
y-m-47-04.s.s1.o.d: Hazvigoni kusarudzwa, nokuti hatizivi zvikamu zveseti yose U
y-m-47-04.s.s1.r.d: U yatopiwa senhamba dzechisikigo kubva pa1 kusvika pa12. Fungazve kuti chii chisingagoni kuzivikanwa.
y-m-47-04.s.s1.explain: Ruzivo harukwani. Kuti 'kana p saka q' ive yechokwadi, tinoda P⊂Q, asi ne n(P)=4 ne n(Q)=7 chete hatigoni kuziva kana zvikamu 4 zvaP zviri mukati meQ. Pane nyaya umo P⊂Q nenyaya umo kwete.
y-m-47-04.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza nyaya dzose umo, kana ukadzidza ruzivo rumwe zvakare, zvinosarudzwa kana 'kana p saka q' iri yechokwadi kana yenhema. (Hazvina basa kana zvasarudzwa seyechokwadi kana yenhema.)
y-m-47-04.s.s2.hint.0: Wana kuti sarudzo imwe neimwe inogadzika n(P∩Q) pakukosha kupi.
y-m-47-04.s.s2.hint.1: Dhirowa kuti P neQ zvinoita sei kana n(P∩Q) i4 uye kana iri pasi pe4.
y-m-47-04.s.s2.r.a: Uku kukosha kwaunogona kuziva kubva pa n(P)=4 ne U ine zvikamu 12. Ongorora kana iri ruzivo rutsva.
y-m-47-04.s.s2.o.c: Chimwe chezvikamu zvaP kana kupfuura chinoenderawo kuQ
y-m-47-04.s.s2.r.c: Edza kana, kubva pakuti chimwe chavo chiri muQ, unogona kutaura kuti vamwe 3 vari muQ futi.
y-m-47-04.s.s2.explain: Kana n(P∩Q)=4, zvikamu zvose zvaP zviri muQ, saka yechokwadi, uye kana n(P∪Q)=7, zvikamu 7 zveQ ndizvo zvose zveP∪Q, saka P⊂Q uye yechokwadi. Kana n(P∪Q)=10, saka n(P∩Q)=4+7−10=1, saka zvikamu 3 zvaP zviri kunze kweQ uye yenhema. n(Pᶜ)=8 inotaura chinhu chimwe chete neruzivo rwatoziva, uye ruzivo rwekuti chimwe kana kupfuura chinoenderawo hairevi chinhu pamusoro pezvikamu zvasara.
y-m-47-04.s.s3.prompt: Rega n(P∪Q)=u, uye uwane kukosha 2 kwakasiyana kwe u kusingapokani neruzivo rwekutanga uye kunoita kuti chirevo 'kana p saka q' chive chenhema. (u inhamba yechisikigo.)
y-m-47-04.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora mutebhura kuti n(P∩Q)=4+7−u inochinja sei sezvo u ichikura.
y-m-47-04.s.s3.hint.1: Kana n(P∩Q) iri pasi pe4, verenga zvikamu zvaP zviri kunze kweQ zvingani.

y-m-47-07.title: Kusarudza nekugadzira wega mamiriro maviri emamultiples
y-m-47-07.topic: Kugadzira hukama hunodiwa nehwakakwana hwemamiriro akawanda
y-m-47-07.goal: Tonga hukama hwekusanganisira hwemamiriro maviri akagadzirwa nemamultiples, gadzira mapeya akawanda emamiriro umo rimwe rakakwana asi risingadiwi, uye utonge hukama kana nzira yachinjwa.
y-m-47-07.material: Unoda kugadzira mamiriro maviri nezve nhamba yechisikigo x: 'p: x imultiple ye a' ne 'q: x imultiple ye b'. Zvichienderana nekuti ungasarudza sei a ne b, p inogona kuva mamiriro akakwana kuna q, mamiriro anodiwa, kana kwete chero. (Kana 'kana p saka q' yechokwadi, p mamiriro akakwana kuna q.)
y-m-47-07.thinking.0: Kutonga mamiriro nehukama hwekusanganisira hwemaseti echokwadi
y-m-47-07.thinking.1: Kugadzira wega mapeya akasiyana anoita chirambidzo
y-m-47-07.prereq.0: Zvinoreva multiple nezvinoreva mamiriro anodiwa nemamiriro akakwana (H1 yebatch iyi inongova danho rekuoma netsigiro uye haireve kuti yakapiwa kugiredhi rakati. Fungidzira kuti mudzidzi ari kudzidza yuniti ye 'Sets and Propositions' yeCommon Mathematics yechikoro chepamusoro.)
y-m-47-07.prereq.1: Kutonga p⇒q nehukama hwekusanganisira hwemaseti echokwadi
y-m-47-07.s.s1.prompt: Kunhamba yechisikigo x, p: x imultiple ye12, q: x imultiple ye8. p imamiriro erudzi rupi kuna q?
y-m-47-07.s.s1.hint.0: Rondedzera mamultiples mashoma e12 nemamultiples mashoma e8.
y-m-47-07.s.s1.hint.1: Edza wega kana nzira dzose mbiri, kubva ku p kuenda ku q nekubva ku q kuenda ku p, dzichigara dzichishanda.
y-m-47-07.s.s1.r.a: Ongorora zvakananga ne12, 24, 36 kana multiple yega yega ye12 iri multiple ye8.
y-m-47-07.s.s1.r.b: Tsvaga multiple ye8 isiri multiple ye12.
y-m-47-07.s.s1.r.c: Tanga waongorora nzira: i 'kana p saka q' kana yakapesana? Tarisawo kana pane multiple ye12 isiri multiple ye8.
y-m-47-07.s.s1.explain: Pakati pemamultiples e12, pane nhamba sa12 dzisiri mamultiples e8, saka haisi mamiriro akakwana, uye pakati pemamultiples e8, pane nhamba sa8 dzisiri mamultiples e12, saka haisi mamiriro anodiwa futi.
y-m-47-07.s.s2.prompt: p: x imultiple ye a, q: x imultiple ye b (x inhamba yechisikigo, a ne b maintegers kubva pa2 kusvika pa100). Gadzira (a, b) 3 dzakasiyana umo p imamiriro akakwana kuna q asi risiri mamiriro anodiwa.
y-m-47-07.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza nhamba diki a ne b, rondedzera mamultiples mashoma e a ne e b, uye uongorore hukama hwekusanganisira.
y-m-47-07.s.s2.hint.1: Edza kuti hukama hupi hunofanira kuvapo pakati pe a ne b kuti mamultiples ose e a ave mamultiples e b.
y-m-47-07.s.s2.ok.c1: a ne b maintegers kubva pa2 kusvika pa100.
y-m-47-07.s.s2.fail.c1: a ne b zvinofanira kuva maintegers kubva pa2 kusvika pa100.
y-m-47-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Multiple yega yega ye a imultiple ye b (mamiriro akakwana).
y-m-47-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Kuti multiple yega yega ye a ive multiple ye b, a inofanira kuva multiple ye b. Ongorora kana pane multiple ye a isiri multiple ye b.
y-m-47-07.s.s2.ok.c3: Pane nhamba inoita q asi isiri p (haisi mamiriro anodiwa).
y-m-47-07.s.s2.fail.c3: Kana a=b mamiriro maviri akafanana, saka inova mamiriro anodiwa nemamiriro akakwana.
y-m-47-07.s.s2.explain: Mapeya sa (12, 4), (6, 3), (10, 5), (9, 3) anogoneka. Kana a imultiple ye b uye dzakasiyana, multiple yega yega ye a imultiple ye b, asi b pachayo haisi multiple ye a.
y-m-47-07.s.s2.because.prompt: Sarudza imwe ye (a, b) yako, uye unyore kuti nei 'kana p saka q' inogara ichishanda uye muenzaniso wenhamba inoita q asi isiri p.
y-m-47-07.s.s2.because.hint.0: Kune (a, b) yawakasarudza, tanga wanyora kuti a inogona kunyorwa sei se b nguva nhamba imwe.
y-m-47-07.s.s2.because.hint.1: Paradzanisa zvakananga kuti utarise kana b pachayo ichisangana na p.
y-m-47-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakatarisa here nokuparadzanisa kuti nhamba yandakapa chaizvo kuwanda kwenhamba ya q uye kwete kuwanda kwenhamba ya p?
y-m-47-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Tsananguro yako inosanganisira here kuti 'kuwanda kwe a kune chimiro chokuti b nguva nhamba imwe'?
y-m-47-07.s.s2.because.model.0: Ndakasarudza a=12, b=4. Kuwanda kwe 12 kunogara kuri kuwanda kwe 4 nokuti 12=4×3. Asi 4 kuwanda kwe 4 uye hakuri kuwanda kwe 12, saka haisi mamiriro anodikanwa.
y-m-47-07.s.s2.because.model.1: Ndi (6, 3). Kuwanda kwose kwe 6 kuwanda kwe 3 nokuti 6=3×2. Zvakapesana, 3 kuwanda kwe 3 asi kwete kwe 6, saka muenzaniso unopikisa.
y-m-47-07.s.s2.because.model.2: Ndi (12, 3). Sezvo 12=3×4, kuwanda kwe 12 kunogara kuri kuwanda kwe 3. Asi 3 kuwanda kwe 3 uye hakuri kuwanda kwe 12.
y-m-47-07.s.s2.because.model.3: Tinogona kunyora a=b×k, saka kuwanda kwe a kunova kuwanda kwe b. b pachayo inosangana na q asi haisangani na p.
y-m-47-07.s.s3.prompt: Kana ukachinjana a ne b zvepeya yawakagadzira pachikamu chapfuura uye ukaita p: x ndiko kuwanda kwe b, q: x ndiko kuwanda kwe a, p ichava mamiriro akaita sei kuna q? (Fungidzira kuti a kuwanda kwe b uye dzakasiyana.)
y-m-47-07.s.s3.hint.0: Isa nhamba chaidzo se (a, b)=(12, 4) uye unyore kuwanda kwe p ne q dzakachinjana.
y-m-47-07.s.s3.hint.1: Tarisa nzira: kuwanda kwechipi kwakazara mukuwanda kwechimwe.
y-m-47-07.s.s3.r.a: Kana p iri kuwanda kwe b uye q iri kuwanda kwe a, yedza kana b, muenzaniso wa p, ichisangana na q.
y-m-47-07.s.s3.r.c: Yedza kana, a ne b dzakasiyana, kuwanda kwemamiriro maviri kungava kwakafanana.
y-m-47-07.s.s3.r.d: Yedza nenhamba chaidzo kuti hukama hupi hwokupinda hunoitwa nechokwadi chokuti a kuwanda kwe b pakati pemamiriro maviri.
y-m-47-07.s.s3.explain: Kana a kuwanda kwe b uye dzakasiyana, kuwanda kwose kwe a kuwanda kwe b. Mushure mokuchinjana, kuwanda kwose kwa q kuwanda kwa p, saka 'kana q saka p', ndiko kuti, p mamiriro anodikanwa. Asi b inosangana na p uye haisangani na q, saka haisi mamiriro anokwana.

y-m-47-06.title: Kuongorora humbowo hwe 'kana a+b>10 saka ...'
y-m-47-06.goal: Enzanisa kukodzera kwenzira dzehumbowo, wana kukanganisa kunoitwa kana mhedziso ichirambwa uye ugadzirise contrapositive, uye ugadzire wega counterexample kucontrapositive isina kururama.
y-m-47-06.material: Tarisa nzira dzekuratidza chirevo 'kunhamba chaiyo a, b, kana a+b>10 saka a>5 kana b>5', nehumbowo hwemudzidzi mumwe. (a>5 inoverengwa 'a is greater than 5'.)
y-m-47-06.prereq.0: Contrapositive yechirevo, kuramba kwe 'kana' ne 'uye', nehunhu hweinequalities (H1 yebatch iyi inongova danho rekuoma netsigiro uye haireve kuti yakapiwa kugiredhi rakati. Fungidzira kuti mudzidzi ari kudzidza yuniti ye 'Sets and Propositions' yeCommon Mathematics yechikoro chepamusoro.)
y-m-47-06.prereq.1: Mudzidzi anoziva kuti contrapositive ine chokwadi chakafanana nechirevo chekutanga
y-m-47-06.s.s1.prompt: Unoda kuratidza chirevo 'kunhamba chaiyo a, b, kana a+b>10 saka a>5 kana b>5'. Sarudza nzira dzose dzehumbowo dzakakodzera.
y-m-47-06.s.s1.hint.0: Pasarudzo yega yega, shanda kana ichiratidza kuti chirevo chinoshanda 'kumapeya ose enhamba chaiyo'.
y-m-47-06.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora seinequalities kuti 'a>5 kana b>5' kuva yenhema zvinoreva chii.
y-m-47-06.s.s1.o.a: Ratidza kuti a+b>10 inoputsika pasi pemamiriro anorambisa mhedziso
y-m-47-06.s.s1.o.b: Sarudza mapeya mashoma enhamba ane a+b>10 uye uongorore kuti mhedziso yakarurama
y-m-47-06.s.s1.r.b: Shanda kana kuongorora mienzaniso mishoma kuchiratidza kuti inoshanda kumapeya ose enhamba chaiyo.
y-m-47-06.s.s1.o.c: Wana kukosha kwe a ne b zvakananga uye uzvienzanise ne5
y-m-47-06.s.s1.r.c: Edza kana a+b>10 yoga ichisarudza kukosha kwe a ne b kuita kukosha kumwe.
y-m-47-06.s.s1.o.d: Fungidzira kuti mhedziso yenhema uone kana kupokana kuchimuka
y-m-47-06.s.s1.explain: Kuratidza kuti a+b≤10 pasi pemamiriro anorambisa mhedziso (a≤5 uye b≤5) kuratidza contrapositive, uye kufungidzira kuti mhedziso yenhema nekuratidza kupokana ne a+b>10 inzirawo yakakodzera. Kuongorora mapeya mashoma enhamba hakusi humbowo, uye hypothesis yoga haisarudze kukosha kwe a ne b.
y-m-47-06.s.s2.prompt: Imwe yeidzi yakaratidzwa uchishandisa contrapositive. Sarudza mutsara wekutanga usina kururama.
y-m-47-06.s.s2.hint.0: Gadzira contrapositive iwe amene. Tanga wanyora kuti inequality ipi yaunowana nekuramba mhedziso 'a>5 kana b>5'.
y-m-47-06.s.s2.hint.1: Famba pasi mutsara nemutsara kubva kumusoro, isa chirevo chemutsara iwoyo mumapeya enhamba, uye uedze kana chichitevera zvakanaka kubva kumutsara wapfuura.
y-m-47-06.s.s2.line.0: Chirevo chekuratidza: kana a+b>10 saka a>5 kana b>5.
y-m-47-06.s.s2.line.1: Ratidza contrapositive. Contrapositive: kana a≤5 kana b≤5 saka a+b≤10.
y-m-47-06.s.s2.line.2: Kana a≤5 uye b≤5, saka a+b≤5+5=10.
y-m-47-06.s.s2.line.3: Contrapositive yechokwadi, saka chirevo chekutanga chiri chechokwadiwo.
y-m-47-06.s.s2.explain: Mutsara 2 ndiwo wekutanga usina kururama. Kuramba kwe "a>5 kana b>5" i"a≤5 uye b≤5," asi kwakanyorwa ne"kana." Saka contrapositive yakava chirevo chenhema (semuenzaniso, kana a=5, b=100, saka a≤5 asi a+b>10), uye mhedziso yemutsara 4 inotsamirawo pacontrapositive isina kururama iyoyo. Kuverenga kwemutsara 3 kwakarurama munyaya ye"uye," asi hakuratidzi zvinotaurwa nemutsara 2.
y-m-47-06.s.s3.prompt: Unoda kuratidza kuti 'contrapositive' yakanyorwa mumutsara 2 chirevo chenhema. Wana mapeya 3 akasiyana emaintegers (a, b) umo 'a≤5 kana b≤5' inoshanda asi a+b≤10 haishande. (Kubva pa−1000 kusvika pa1000; (a, b) ne (b, a) zvinoverengwa semuenzaniso mumwe.)
y-m-47-06.s.s3.hint.0: Mushure mekusarudza a ine kukosha kwe5 kana pasi, wana kuti b inofanira kuva chii kuti huwandu hupfuure 10.
y-m-47-06.s.s3.hint.1: Kupeya yega yega yausarudza, ongorora 'a≤5 kana b≤5' ne 'a+b>10' wega.
y-m-47-06.s.s3.fail.c1: a ne b zvinofanira kuva maintegers kubva pa−1000 kusvika pa1000.
y-m-47-06.s.s3.fail.c2: Kana a ne b zvose zvakakura kupfuura 5, 'a≤5 kana b≤5' haishande.
y-m-47-06.s.s3.fail.c3: Kana a+b i10 kana pasi, mhedziso yechirevo ichi inopedzisira ichishanda.
y-m-47-06.s.s3.explain: Mapeya sa (5, 6), (0, 11), (4, 20) macounterexamples. Kunyange kana imwe i5 kana pasi, kana imwe yakakura zvakakwana huwandu hunopfuura 10. Contrapositive chaiyo i 'kana a≤5 uye b≤5 saka a+b≤10'.

y-m-47-09.title: Mutsara une 'dzimwe' unosarudzwa riini?
y-m-47-09.goal: Nzwisisa kuti mutsara wechimiro 'pane dzimwe ...' unosarudzwa seuri wechokwadi nomuenzaniso mumwe unoshanda uye hausarudzwi seusiri wechokwadi kunyange mienzaniso yakawanda yakatadza, nyora kupikisa zvakarurama, uye utsvage iwe pachako kukosha kunosangana namamiriro.
y-m-47-09.material: Mutsara S: 'Kune dzimwe nhamba chaiyo x, x²<x.' (x² ndi x yakaitwa sikweya.) Unoda kuisa kukosha rimwe panguva imwe uye uone kuti S inosarudzwa riini kuti ichokwadi kana kwete. Fungidzira kuti unogona kuyedza kukosha kumwe chete panguva imwe.
y-m-47-09.thinking.0: Kutarisa nokugadzirisa kutonga kwako zvichienderana nemhedzisiro dzomuedzo
y-m-47-09.prereq.0: Chirevo chezvirevo zve 'dzose' ne 'dzimwe' nezvakapikisana nazvo, nokutarisa kusaenzana x²<x nokuisa nhamba (H1 yeboka iri inongova nhanho yokuoma nokutsigira uye haireve kuti yakapiwa kugiredhi rakati. Fungidzira kuti mudzidzi ari kudzidza yuniti ye 'Sets and Propositions' yeCommon Mathematics yechikoro chepamusoro.)
y-m-47-09.s.s1.prompt: Kumutsara une 'pane dzimwe ...', kukosha kungani kunofanira kuyedzwa kuti kuti ichokwadi kana kwete kusarudzwe? Sezvo mhedzisiro dzomuedzo dzichiunganidzwa, tarisa kutonga kwako.
y-m-47-09.s.s1.hint.0: Nyorazve chirevo chomutsara S se 'pane nhamba chaiyo imwe kana kupfuura yakadaro'.
y-m-47-09.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora kukosha kwakayedzwa patafura uye uenzanise hukuru hwa x ne x² kune imwe neimwe.
y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.0.info: Mutsara S: 'Kune dzimwe nhamba chaiyo x, x²<x.' (x² ndi x yakaitwa sikweya.) Semuedzo wekutanga ndakaisa x=2, uye 2²=4, uye 4<2 hazvisi zvechokwadi.
y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kutonga kupi kwaunogona kuita pamusoro pa S ikozvino?
y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.0.after: x=2 isingasangani namamiriro inongoreva 'x=2 haiiti kuti S ive yechokwadi'. Unogona kunge uine manzwiro okuti zvinoratidzika zvisiri zvechokwadi. 'Dzimwe' dzechokwadi kana paine kunyange kukosha kumwe kunosangana, saka kana kukosha kusina kuyedzwa kuchisara, haugoni kusarudza.
y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Tsvaga kuti zvinoratidza chii pamusoro pomutsara wose kana kukosha kumwe kusingashande kwabuda mumutsara une 'dzimwe'.
y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Tarisa kana kukosha kumwe kunoshanda kwabuda.
y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Zvinoratidzika zvisiri zvechokwadi asi hatisati tazviziva
y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.1.info: Ndakaisawo x=−1, 0, 3, 10, uye zvose x²<x hazvisi zvechokwadi (x²≥x).
y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.1.ask: Huwandu hwekukosha kwakayedzwa hwakawedzera kusvika pa 5. Kutonga kwako pamusoro pa S ikozvino ndekupi?
y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.1.after: Kunyange kana kukosha kwose kwakayedzwa kwakatadza, kana kukosha kusina kuyedzwa kuchisara, S haisarudzwi. Unogona kunge uine manzwiro okuti zvinoratidzika zvisiri zvechokwadi, asi iko hakusi humbowo. Kuti usarudze, unofanira kuratidza kuti sei mamiriro anoputsika kunhamba chaiyo dzose.
y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Tsvaga kana wakasimbiswa kuti pakati pekukosha kunosara kunze kwe 5 kwakayedzwa, hapana kunosangana namamiriro.
y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Zvinoratidzika zvisiri zvechokwadi asi hazvisati zvasarudzwa
y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kubva pamhedzisiro yomuedzo uyu, kutonga kwako pamusoro pa S ndekupi?
y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.2.after: 'Kune dzimwe x, ...' ichokwadi kana paine kunyange x imwe inoshanda. Inoshanda pa x=0.5, saka kunyange kukosha kwakawanda kwakatadza pamberi, S ichokwadi.
y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.2.o.a: S haisi yechokwadi. Haina kushanda kuna x dzakawanda
y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Tarisa zvinoitika kana paine kunyange kukosha kumwe kunoshanda, kwete 'dzakawanda'.
y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Kukosha kunoshanda kwabuda chaizvo. Verenga zvakare kuti kukosha uku kune simba rakadini pachirevo chomutsara S.
y-m-47-09.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga hatina kukwanisa kutonga, uye kunyange mienzaniso yakatadza ichiunganidzwa yakanga isiri 'yasarudzwa', asi kana muenzaniso mumwe unoshanda wabuda wakasarudzwa. Enzanisa kuti basa remuenzaniso mumwe rinosiyana sei pakati pomutsara une 'dzimwe' nomutsara une 'dzose'.
y-m-47-09.s.s2.prompt: Kupikisa kunokodzera kwomutsara S: 'Kune dzimwe nhamba chaiyo x, x²<x' ndekupi?
y-m-47-09.s.s2.hint.0: Yedza na x=0.5 ne x=2 kana S nomutsara uri musarudzo zvingava zvechokwadi panguva imwe chete.
y-m-47-09.s.s2.hint.1: Yedza na x=0 kuti chiratidzo chokusaenzana chinofanira kuchinja sei kana ukachinja 'dzimwe' kuva 'dzose'.
y-m-47-09.s.s2.o.a: Kune nhamba chaiyo x dzose, x²>x
y-m-47-09.s.s2.r.a: Tarisa kana kupikisa kwe '<' kuri '>'. Hukama pakati pa x² ne x hupi kana x=0?
y-m-47-09.s.s2.o.b: Kune dzimwe nhamba chaiyo x, x²≥x
y-m-47-09.s.s2.r.b: Yakasiya 'dzimwe' sezvayakaita uye yakachinja chete chiratidzo chokusaenzana. Tarisa kana x=2 ichiita kuti mutsara uyu uve wechokwadi, uye kana uyu ungava kupikisa kwa S.
y-m-47-09.s.s2.o.c: Kune dzimwe nhamba chaiyo x, x²>x
y-m-47-09.s.s2.r.c: Tarisa kana S nomutsara uyu zvingava zvechokwadi pamwe chete.
y-m-47-09.s.s2.o.d: Kune nhamba chaiyo x dzose, x²≥x
y-m-47-09.s.s2.explain: Kupikisa kwa 'pane dzimwe ...' ndi 'kune ... dzose, hazvisi kudaro'. Kupikisa kwa x²<x ndi x²≥x (kusanganisira x²=x), saka 'kune nhamba chaiyo x dzose, x²≥x' ndiko kupikisa. Zvisinei, S ichokwadi, saka kupikisa uku hakusi kwechokwadi. x=0.5 muenzaniso unopikisa.
y-m-47-09.s.s3.prompt: Kuratidza kuti S ichokwadi, unoda x imwe inosangana namamiriro. Tsvaga nhamba chaiyo 3 dzakasiyana x dzinosangana na x²<x.
y-m-47-09.s.s3.hint.0: Isa nhamba iri pakati pe 0 ne 1 se x=0.5 uye uverenge x² ne x rimwe nerimwe.
y-m-47-09.s.s3.hint.1: Chinja x pakati pe 0 ne 1 uye utsvage mhando apo x² inova diki kupfuura x.
y-m-47-09.s.s3.fail.c1: x²<x haishande. Isa 0.1, 0.5, 2, nezvimwewo pa x uye uenzanise x² ne x.
y-m-47-09.s.s3.explain: Nhamba chaiyo dzose pakati pe 0 ne 1 dzinogoneka. Kana x iri 0 kana 1, x²=x, uye kana x iri huru kupfuura 1 kana negative, x²>x.
